counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit mention of central corneal guttata in C1's raw span
No family history support in C1
decisive_items: There is a family history of Fuchs’ endothelial dystrophy and microspherophakia.
Slit-lamp evaluation revealed peripheral microcystic corneal edema with central corneal sparing in both eyes and central corneal guttata.
response.rationale: R2 directly cites both family history and characteristic corneal findings (edema, guttata), while C1 only cites the corneal findings and adds an anatomical modifier without additional raw evidence. R3 is a historical lens condition not the presenting diagnosis.

rejected.why: Microspherophakia is a past history and not the cause of current corneal edema/guttata; lacks direct support for the presenting syndrome.
